name: Animal Charity Evaluators
summary: Evaluates animal advocacy charities, recommends the ones it finds most effective, and passes donors' money to them through its Recommended Charity Fund and to small groups through its Movement Grants. In its year to March 2025 it traced $12.3 million of giving to its Recommended Charities and awarded $1.2 million in Movement Grants. A gift to ACE itself pays for its evaluations, grantmaking and fundraising.

spending.source: https://animalcharityevaluators.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/FY2024-25-audit-report.pdf (Animal Charity Evaluators, audited financial statements, year to 31 March 2025, Bonk, Cushman, Eagle & Garcia: programme services $5,883,860, of which grants passed on from donors $4,624,785 and Google's donated advertising $161,448; the grants are the recipients' cost, counted in their own models, so the programme here is charity evaluations, Movement Grants grantmaking and meta fundraising, $1,097,627. Management and general $484,353, fundraising $214,533 ($80,724 of it donated advertising).)

lines.label: Charity evaluations, Movement Grants and fundraising for its Recommended Charities
lines.source: https://animalcharityevaluators.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/FY2024-25-audit-report.pdf (Statement of Functional Expenses, p. 5: charity evaluations $489,026, Movement Grants grantmaking $258,217, meta fundraising $5,136,617 less grants passed on $4,624,785 and donated advertising $161,448; the three accounts lines are one line here because one model covers them, their costs being staff time allocated between them and their results one count of money moved)
